user.title: TPER Tracker Setup
user.description: Search for your bus stop by name, address, or stop number. The first search downloads the TPER stop list and may take a few seconds.

reconfigure.title: Change Stop
reconfigure.description: Search for the new bus stop. Lines served at both stops keep their sensors, history and automations.

select_stop.title: Select Stop
select_stop.description: Choose your bus stop from the results:

select_lines.title: Select Lines
select_lines.description: Choose which bus lines to monitor at {stop}:

error.cannot_connect: Could not download the TPER stop list. Check internet and retry.
error.no_stops_found: No stops found. Try different keywords.
error.invalid_query: Invalid search query. Please enter a valid stop name or number.
error.invalid_line_selection: Invalid line selection. Please select at least one valid line (max 20).

abort.already_configured: This stop is already configured. Use **Configure** to modify lines.

init.title: Edit Options
init.description: Select which bus lines to monitor, and optionally when to track them.

data.active_entity: Active only while this is on

data_description.active_entity: Optional. Live data is fetched only while this entity is on, for example a Schedule helper with your commute times. Leave empty to track all day.

error.invalid_line_selection: Invalid line selection. Please select at least one valid line (max 20).

abort.cannot_connect: Could not download the TPER stop list. Check internet and retry.

rate_limited.message: TPER rate limit reached, live data paused for about {minutes} minutes.

cannot_connect.message: Could not reach TPER Hello Bus for stop {stop_id}.

stop_not_found.title: TPER stop no longer exists
stop_not_found.description: The stop of **{title}** is no longer in the TPER stop list, so it will not get live data. Open the integration and choose **Reconfigure** to pick another stop.

confirm.title: Stop tracking lines not served
confirm.description: Line(s) **{lines}** are not served at **{title}**. Submit to stop tracking them; their sensors will be removed.

abort.entry_not_loaded: The integration is not loaded. Try again once it is running.
abort.no_lines_left: No line of this stop is served. Use **Reconfigure** to pick another stop.

no_lines_served.title: No tracked line served at {title}
no_lines_served.description: TPER Hello Bus does not serve any tracked line (**{lines}**) at the stop of **{title}**. Open the integration and choose **Reconfigure** to pick another stop.

active_entity_missing.title: Active hours entity not found
active_entity_missing.description: **{title}** is set to track buses only while `{entity_id}` is on, but that entity does not exist. Live data is fetched all day until you choose another entity or clear the option in the integration settings.
